question: Which of the following festivals is NOT celebrated primarily in Arunachal Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Losoong__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Losoong** festival is one of the prominent events in **Sikkim**, in North East India.
 
• The **Sikkimese New Year begins with Losoong**, which is celebrated with enthusiasm throughout the province.
 
• The event takes place at the end of the harvesting season, which gives joy and excitement to all of the farmers. 
 
• **Cham dances **performed by **Buddhist monks** are the main attraction of this festival.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tamladu **is one of the ancient and popular festivals observed in the Lohit district of Arunachal Pradesh, it is a prayer offered to the God of Earth and God of Earth.
 
• **Sangken **festival is celebrated in Arunachal Pradesh and parts of Assam, India as a traditional new year's day from 14 to 16 April.
 
• **Ojiyale **festival is celebrated in **Arunachal Pradesh **an agricultural festival by the **Galo tribe.**
